nextcloud.description:
Nextcloud is a free and open-source Android client for accessing, synchronizing, and sharing files stored on your own Nextcloud server or a trusted Nextcloud provider.

Browse your private cloud storage, upload and download files, organize folders, share documents, and access your photos and videos from anywhere.

Features include automatic photo and video uploads, offline file access, favorite folder synchronization, multi-account support, file search, activity notifications, and secure access using a PIN or biometric authentication.

Nextcloud also integrates with other services in the Nextcloud ecosystem, providing access to personal and collaborative documents, media, and productivity tools. Calendar and contacts synchronization can be configured through compatible applications such as DAVx5.

Designed for privacy and digital independence, Nextcloud allows you to keep control of your data instead of relying on proprietary cloud storage providers.

A Nextcloud server or hosted Nextcloud account is required to use the app.
